title: National Health Insurance Law, 5754-1994
source_id: ס״ח תשנ״ד, 156; Knesset legislation database lawitemid 2000111; Wikisource page חוק ביטוח בריאות ממלכתי
verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page. Heading prints חוק ביטוח בריאות ממלכתי, התשנ״ד–1994; metadata gives the Sefer HaChukim citation at page 156 of the התשנ״ד volume and Knesset lawitemid 2000111; original enactment 18 Tevet 5754 (January 1994). The amendment list runs through תשפ״ו, with one amendment on postal-service provisions noted as taking effect 31 December 2026, and the page carries several temporary provisions (הוראת שעה) with stated expiry dates.
notes: In-kind benefit rather than cash: universal health cover, the health basket (סל הבריאות) in the Second Schedule, the sick funds (קופות החולים), and the health insurance contribution (דמי ביטוח בריאות) which is collected by the National Insurance Institute alongside national insurance contributions - which is why this Law also touches Personal tax/withholding in practice. in_force is 'yes', but note there is at least one amendment with a future commencement (31 December 2026) and several live הוראת שעה provisions: a point-in-time date is mandatory for any encoding. The health basket content is updated by order/regulation annually, not by amending the Law.
